title: Degree of a Boolean derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the Boolean cube over the two-element field to that field, and let $y$ be any point of the cube. The algebraic degree of the Boolean derivative of $f$ in direction $y$ is at most the algebraic degree of $f$ minus one, where subtraction is in the natural numbers.
